C-DOCUMENT-RUNTIME-RELIABILITY-235-FINAL.Summary: Finish Unicode-safe document intake, classified Docomator diagnostics and strict recoverable OCR full-bundle activation.
C-DOCUMENT-RUNTIME-RELIABILITY-235-FINAL.Problem: The current release can lose actionable integration errors, reject Unicode-derived HTTP headers and accept an incomplete document runtime. The direct full-bundle entrypoint must prove the target payload and OCR before the existing application update transaction starts.

Goals.Goal: Keep the original document name, bytes, SHA-256, version and evidence while canonicalizing idempotency headers to bounded ASCII.
Expose only safe classified Docomator failures and preserve entered connection values.
Atomically retain the exact target package payload for offline repair.
Run additive package preparation, full preflight and a real control OCR before invoking the existing transactional installer.
Leave the previous release and data active when strict document-runtime acceptance fails.

Constraints.Constraint: No schema, migration, release-version, Docker, CDN, mandatory Internet, cloud or mandatory LLM change.
Package operations never upgrade, downgrade, remove, pin package versions or run apt --fix-broken.
The existing application backup, migration, service and rollback transaction remains the source of truth.
Access code and all security-sensitive actions remain never-learn; errors use no decorative motion.

NonGoals.NonGoal: Scan a network or guess ports.
Make OCR or Docomator mandatory for calendar, tasks and stored source access.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Russian, mixed, emoji and long filenames reach document upload on desktop and mobile without changing source identity or creating duplicates on repeat.
DNS, refused connection, timeout, TLS, wrong service, not ready and denied access are distinct; unknown 5xx details remain private.
A verified profile-bound package set is copied atomically to an immutable cache before package mutation.
The published offline entrypoint exits before application update when package preparation, required capabilities or control OCR fail.
doctor --repair reuses the retained cache without Internet and ends with the same strict self-test.
GRACE final, focused tests, full CI, release, offline and systemd gates pass on one exact head before squash merge and terminal archive.

VerificationIntent.ExpectedCommand: node --test tests/document-runtime-release.test.mjs tests/http-headers.test.mjs tests/http-utils.test.mjs tests/docomator-integration.test.mjs tests/offline-package-policy.test.mjs
VerificationIntent.ExpectedEvidence: The exact branch head proves the complete document-runtime path without changing data authority or weakening recovery.
